description: Create a project in the connected LoopGantt ACCOUNT (requires signing in to LoopGantt, or an API key). For a keyless chart use create_gantt instead. Pass workflow: "agent_board" for a board a team of agents works on - stages todo, in_progress, blocked, waiting_approval, done (done is the finished stage).

workflow.description: Board columns preset. agent_board = todo, in_progress, blocked, waiting_approval, done. Omit for the default stages (not_started, in_progress, on_hold, completed).

name: create_project
